author: Claude taslak (H-069); kullanıcı onayı bekliyor
notes: Anlatım İngilizcede geniş zamanda (present simple); Türkçede doğal anlatım için çoğunlukla şimdiki zaman (-iyor) kullanıldı.
Kelime anlamları cümledeki kullanıma göre verildi; -s takısı olan fiillerde (lives, has, goes) not düşüldü.

lines.en: Today she has a new home.
It is an old building on a river.
Lina and her mum live on floor four.
lines.tr: Lina ve annesi dördüncü katta oturuyor.

lines.en: On the top floor, there is one door.
lines.tr: En üst katta tek bir kapı var.

lines.en: Who lives behind the blue door?
Mum carries boxes into the flat.
In one box, there is a red pot.
lines.tr: Bir kutuda kırmızı bir saksı var.

lines.en: There is a flower in it.
She puts it on her window.
There is not much sun here.
In the evening, Lina meets two neighbours.
Mr Tom lives on floor one.
He has a big grey cat.
Mrs Ada lives on floor two.

lines.tr: Yaşlı ve ufak tefek bir kadın.

lines.en: "Who lives behind the blue door?" asks Lina.
lines.tr: "Mavi kapının arkasında kim yaşıyor?" diye soruyor Lina.

lines.en: Then she goes into her flat.
The building is quiet and dark.
There is a light under the blue door!
lines.tr: Mavi kapının altında bir ışık var!

lines.en: It is a warm yellow light.
At ten o'clock, the light goes off.
In the morning, Lina runs up again.
lines.tr: Sabah Lina yine koşarak yukarı çıkıyor.

lines.en: There is something brown on the steps.
It is in front of the blue door.
One: a light at nine o'clock.
She looks at the steps again.
It goes down to floor three.
Then it goes down to floor two.
It stops at a green door.
It is the door of Mrs Ada.
"Your flower is very dry," says Mrs Ada.
Her flower is on floor four.
"Mrs Ada, who lives behind the blue door?" asks Lina.
lines.tr: "Ada Hanım, mavi kapının arkasında kim yaşıyor?" diye soruyor Lina.

lines.en: And I go to bed early.
That night, Lina does not sleep.
She sits behind her door and listens.
At eight o'clock, the building is quiet.
At half past eight, it is quiet, too.
At nine, Lina hears someone on the steps.

lines.tr: Sonra Lina bir anahtar sesi duyuyor.

lines.en: The blue door is open now.
Behind it, there are more steps.
At the top, there is a yellow light.
lines.tr: En üstte sarı bir ışık var.

lines.en: Lina feels the cold night on her face.
Under the lights, there is a garden.
There are red tomatoes and long green beans.
lines.tr: Kırmızı domatesler ve uzun yeşil fasulyeler var.

lines.en: There are many plants and flowers.
lines.tr: Bir sürü bitki ve çiçek var.

lines.en: A small old woman stands in the garden.
lines.tr: Bahçede ufak tefek, yaşlı bir kadın duruyor.

lines.en: She gives water to the tomatoes.
"No one lives here," says Mrs Ada.
Then Mrs Ada opens her hand.
There are two keys in it.
"One key is for me," she says.
"I see your poor flower every day.
Now Lina's flower is on the roof.
It is next to the tomatoes.
A week later, there is a new leaf.
lines.tr: Bir hafta sonra yeni bir yaprak çıkıyor.

phrases.note: Türkçede 'var' tek kelimedir; İngilizcede there is / there are ikilisi kullanılır.
